ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution localized in scar clusters and barnacle colonies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, irregular high-contrast white cluster is located in the upper interior of the left lobe. Discrete circular white pixel sets (rosette patterns) are scattered across the central regions of both lobes. High-density, high-relief white clusters are fixed at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth relative to the central fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration with jagged pixel-amplitude variations across the entire trailing boundary. Notable irregular peaks and valleys occur most frequently on the interior segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward sweep from the peduncle base toward the tips on both lobes, terminating in sharp, barnacle-encrusted points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent circular high-contrast pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes, with extreme concentrations at the distal tips forming textured, three-dimensional rosette colonies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (parallel rake marks) are visible on the upper interior section of the left lobe and lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the superior tips of both lobes; dense field of linear rake marks and circular scarring across the left lobe's ventral surface.
